generate:routes.description: Writes Expo Router's types for the routes in src/app, which Git ignores

check.description: Type-checks the app, with the types of its routes

dev.description: Runs Expo's dev server, which takes keyboard shortcuts

android.description: Builds the app, runs it on Android and keeps Expo's dev server running

ios.description: Builds the app, runs it on iOS and keeps Expo's dev server running
